summary: Aerie is preparing to self-manage three Arizona properties (about 310 units) with a lean, centralized operating model. The strongest configuration direction is property-scoped access, centralized oversight, automated renewals, firm move-in/make-ready controls, human-reviewed maintenance closure, monthly rentable parking, Blue Moon lease forms, and RentVision integration. Exact users, approval authority, maintenance templates, and several AI-routing details still need confirmation before configuration.

settings.setting: Create role-based groups for centralized operations, property managers, leasing, maintenance, and third-party accounting.
settings.path: Setup >> Users & Groups >> Groups >> Add Group
settings.proposed: Create separate Central Operations, Property Manager, Leasing, Maintenance, and Third-Party Accounting groups with least-privilege access.
settings.confirmText: Likely role-based groups — confirm with client: Which responsibilities should Tom, onsite managers, the centralized employee, maintenance staff, and the outside accountant each be allowed to perform?
settings.meaning: Groups will let Aerie standardize access as it retains onsite staff, centralizes leasing, and gives an outside accounting firm controlled system access.
settings.assumption: The proposed group structure reflects Aerie's intended staffing model, but the final roster has not been hired or selected.
reasoning: Aerie wants a centralized employee handling AI escalations, leasing, renewals, and some maintenance scheduling across the portfolio.
Tom expects to act as the regional operator, retain onsite managers, and use a third-party property accounting firm initially.
Aerie explicitly wants access restricted by property, ownership group, role, and AI/data scope.

callsUsed.title: Rent Dynamics (Entrata) <> Aerie Development
callsUsed.brief: Miles and Tom discussed integrating Entrata's RentPlus program into Aerie development's properties managed by Avenue Five, focusing on revenue generation and resident benefits. Miles outlined the program's features, adoption rates, and revenue potential, while Tom explained his company's structure and interest in proposing the program to Avenue Five for both current and future properties. The next steps involve Miles confirming internal alignment and Avenue Five's approval to proceed with a master agreement and property-specific sales orders.

callsUsed.title: Entrata / Aerie Development
callsUsed.brief: Terry from Entrata, along with Tom from Aerie Development, discussed Aerie's pivot from a build-and-sell model to potentially bringing property management in-house due to market changes and dissatisfaction with third-party managers. Tom is exploring property management software that integrates with Elise AI, supports a lean, centralized leasing team, and scales effectively, with Entrata proposing its unified data layer and AI capabilities as a comprehensive solution. They scheduled initial demos to explore Entrata's fit for Aerie's goal of managing properties with a lean team and expanding their property management business.

callsUsed.title: Aerie Dev. + Entrata Lunch/Demo
callsUsed.brief: Tijah and Terry from Entrata, along with Tom from Aerie Development, discussed Entrata's property management software, focusing on its lead-to-lease process, AI capabilities, and integrated features. Key highlights included the system's unified dashboard, granular permissions, automated approval workflows, and advanced lead attribution methods. They also delved into Entrata's "agentic AI agents" for leasing, demonstrating how they handle inquiries, schedule tours, and facilitate human handoffs, all while maintaining a comprehensive audit trail within a single data layer.

callsUsed.title: #2 Demo - Entrata + Aerie Dev
callsUsed.brief: Tijah and Terry from Entrata, along with Tom from Aerie Development, discussed Entrata's platform capabilities, focusing on the move-in process, resident lifecycle management, and automated renewals, with a particular emphasis on AI-driven features for efficiency and compliance. Tom expressed interest in the system's ability to streamline operations and ensure clear governance, while also raising questions about AI limitations and customization. The next meeting will cover remaining topics, including delinquency management and facilities, and will inform a detailed pricing and implementation proposal for Aerie Development.

callsUsed.title: #3 Demo - Entrata + Aerie Dev
callsUsed.brief: Tijah and Terry from Entrata, along with Tom from Aerie Development, discussed Entrata's property management software, focusing on its AI capabilities, accounting features, and integrated governance. Key highlights included Entrata's AI model, Forge, designed for multifamily real estate, and the system's ability to streamline accounting processes like invoice management, budgeting, and bank reconciliation, all within a single, integrated platform. The conversation concluded with plans for a follow-up meeting to discuss pricing and implementation with Aerie Development's president.
